item.title: Our commitment to improving health outcomes with Research Connections
item.description: Dr Charles Young, founding editor-in-chief of Research Connections, shares his vision for the journal. The post Our commitment to improving health outcomes with Research Connections appeared first on Oxford University Press.

item.title: The Oxford Word of the Year 2025 is rage bait

item.title: EEF report reveals Early Number with Numicon increases educators’ confidence in teaching early maths
item.description: Early Number with Numicon is a 14-week professional development course for childminders and nursery practitioners in early years settings. The post EEF report reveals Early Number with Numicon increases educators’ confidence in teaching early maths appeared first on Oxford University Press.

item.title: William Whyte appointed General Editor of the Oxford Dictionary of National Biography
item.description: William Whyte has been appointed General Editor of the ODNB, taking over from Sir David Cannadine in August 2026. The post William Whyte appointed General Editor of the Oxford Dictionary of National Biography appeared first on Oxford University Press.

item.title: Peace named Oxford Children’s Word of the Year for 2025
item.description: Young people from across the UK have voted for peace as the Oxford Children's Word of the Year for 2025. The post Peace named Oxford Children’s Word of the Year for 2025 appeared first on Oxford University Press.

item.title: Hosting Ukrainian academics and research professionals in Oxford
item.description: We hosted a delegation of Ukrainian academics as part of an initiative aimed at upscaling Ukrainian publishing. The post Hosting Ukrainian academics and research professionals in Oxford appeared first on Oxford University Press.

item.title: Why are universities rethinking English language assessment?
item.description: Our new whitepaper examines how traditional English testing often fails to reflect skills students need for academic and professional success. The post Why are universities rethinking English language assessment? appeared first on Oxford University Press.

item.title: Launching the Oxford Test of English Learner Corpora competition
item.description: The Oxford Test of English Learner Corpora is a rich linguistic resource, with a new competition announced for researchers. The post Launching the Oxford Test of English Learner Corpora competition appeared first on Oxford University Press.
